meta.source: docs/HMI errors - 53 screening photographs of the CV1-CV4 SINUMERIK / Inducontrol alarm pages, supplied 2026-10-17
meta.method: Windows.Media.Ocr text recognition was run over all 53 images on 2026-10-17. The transcription is machine-made and is NOT verified against the controlled alarm list or against the machine.
meta.pairingRule: clear = the code and its text could be read together with corroboration (a detail pane spelling out 'code: text', the same pair on two or more screens, or a screen carrying a single alarm). probable = a single multi-alarm screen whose number-column and text-column runs have the same length and line up positionally, with no conflicting candidate seen. unclear = the runs do not line up or two screens give conflicting candidates - the raw OCR is preserved instead of guessing.
meta.fixes: Each entry carries fixStatus (open | in-progress | fixed | not-an-issue) so the maintenance follow-up can be tracked. These are conditions recorded on the real machine screens; the 3D model and its HMI simulation do not reproduce any of them yet.
meta.note: Codes are the SINUMERIK alarm numbers as read by OCR - leading digits and formatting must be confirmed in the controlled alarm list. seenInPhotos is an approximate OCR match count. Where a text is left empty the OCR could not recover it. Conflicts found so far (700306, 700329, 700509, 700603, 700826/BRIX-vs-BRAX) are recorded in the entry notes, not merged.
